notes.title: Gythol Granditti version 1.1
notes.notes:
The game has now been updated to include the following:

- Quest tracking. At any point in the game you can check the start menu and see what your current objective is.

- Full controller support.

- Steam achievements. If you get all 6, you are a certified Gythol master...

- Bug fixes. Numerous bug fixes to improve game performance and issues.

There are no major content changes, this is mostly to enhance and upgrade the game to be more Steam complete.
